source.transition_population: same 370 exact-point Thalassia-loss transitions as community_insurance_v1

interpretation: The pooled 14.3-percentage-point mixed-versus-Thalassia-only occupancy difference is not robust after stable-node saturation. The within-node coefficient remains positive but its frozen 95% bootstrap interval slightly overlaps zero. Persistent transect quality is therefore a plausible contributor to the pooled community-insurance association.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc reference-saturation audit of an already-opened community-insurance endpoint.
Do not call the pooled mixed-versus-alone association causal biodiversity insurance or facilitation.
The positive within-node point estimate is descriptive and does not replace the failed support rule.
Retention of any seagrass does not imply equivalent ecosystem function after Thalassia loss.
Do not subset by bay, alternative species identity, or year to rescue the unsupported primary.
